summary: Resume exact-producer CI artifact ZIP downloads within the existing two-attempt budget and record byte progress.

replay.detail: CI artifact transport only; no runtime, protocol, database, fleet coordination or service interruption change.

manual.detail: No operator action is required. Consumers authenticate the same artifact ID/run/producer, resume only validated byte ranges, and verify the complete ZIP and producer manifest before extraction. Logs report authenticated size, offsets, received bytes and elapsed time; signed URLs and tokens are excluded.

recovery.detail: Each download retains a private partial only across the same two attempts (600 seconds each, 1200 seconds shared transfer budget). Range or integrity mismatch discards it; unfinished inputs never start tests. Reverting the transport restores full-download retries. No automatic job rerun or routing change.
